# Repository instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository contract.

In particular, use the connected GKE MCP server first for questions about the
operator's documents, workspaces, previous research, project state, decisions,
or handoffs. Do not use GKE MCP for ordinary source-code inspection or server
debugging. If `kb.*` tools are unavailable, state that clearly instead of
presenting an ungrounded answer as GKE-backed.

AI assistants are tools, not contributors. Never add AI authorship,
co-authorship trailers, reviewer signatures, or session attribution to commits
or repository content.
